query: 'WITH latest_price AS (
SELECT item_id, max(modified_on) as max_modified_on
FROM public.pricebook
WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL AND price > 0
GROUP BY item_id
)
SELECT im.id as menuitemid, 
       im.name as menuitemname, 
       'Item' as entitytype,
       im.calories :: text as calories,
       NULL :: numeric as protein,
       NULL :: numeric as sugar,
       NULL :: numeric as fat,
       im.is_alcoholic,
       NULL :: boolean as is_vegetarian_item,
       NULL :: boolean as is_vegan_item,
       NULL :: boolean as has_allergen,
       im.item_class_type,
       im.is_active,
       im.is_deleted,
       im.created_on as gms_created_on,
       im.modified_on as gms_modified_on,
       pb.price :: NUMERIC(16,4) / 100 as itemunitprice, 
       pb.modified_on as price_changed_on,
       im.catalog_id as catalogid
FROM public.item_master as im
LEFT JOIN latest_price as lp
       ON im.id = lp.item_id
LEFT JOIN public.pricebook as pb
       ON lp.item_id = pb.item_id
      AND lp.max_modified_on = pb.modified_on

UNION ALL

       ci.modified_on as mapping_modified_on,
       ctlg.is_deleted as is_catalog_deleted,

       ctlg.modified_on as catalog_modified_on,

       ctg.name as categoryname, 
       ctg.created_on as category_created_on,
       ctg.modified_on as category_modified_on,
       ctg.is_active as is_category_active,
       ctg.is_deleted as is_category_deleted,
       ci.item_master_id as menuitemid,

       i.item_class_type,
       i.created_on as item_created_on,
       i.modified_on as item_modified_on, 
       i.is_active as is_item_active,
       i.is_deleted as is_item_deleted

        ON ci.item_master_id = i.id

  AND ctlg.gem_location_id <> ''',

query: 'WITH latest_price AS (
SELECT modifier_id, max(modified_on) as max_modified_on

WHERE 1=1

  AND price > 0

       mm.catalog_id as catalogid,
       mm.name as modifiername,
       mm.min_quantity,
       mm.max_quantity,
       mm.allow_quantity_increment,
       mm.increment_step,
       mm.calories,
       mm.calories_text,
       mm.is_active as is_modifier_active,
       mm.is_deleted as is_modifier_deleted,
       mm.created_on as modifier_created_on,
       mm.modified_on as modifier_modified_on,
       mm.is_default as is_modifier_default,
       mm.default_quantity as modifier_default_quantity,
       mm.is_invisible,
       mm.classification,
       pb.price :: NUMERIC(16,4) / 100 as price,
       pb.modified_on as price_changed_on
FROM public.modifier_master as mm
LEFT JOIN latest_price as lp
       ON mm.id = lp.modifier_id
LEFT JOIN public.pricebook as pb
       ON lp.modifier_id = pb.modifier_id
      AND lp.max_modified_on = pb.modified_on',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.name, k.kioskid, k.kioskname, o.organizationtype, o.status,
       CASE o.status 
       WHEN 0 THEN 'Draft' 
       WHEN 1 THEN 'Onboarding' 
       WHEN 2 THEN 'Live' 
       WHEN 3 THEN 'Cancelled' END as location_status
FROM dim.organization as o
INNER JOIN dim.kiosk as k 
        ON o.id = k.locationid
WHERE o.active = True 
  AND o.status = 2
  AND k.istestkiosk = False',

query: 'select T2.* 
from (
    select T.deviceid,
        T.locationid,
        T.telemetryvalue as cpuvalue,
        T.telemetrytime as cputimestamp,
        T.dateid,
        row_number() over(partition by T.deviceid, T.locationid, T.dateid order by T.telemetryvalue desc, T.telemetrytime desc) as rownum,
        'fact.devicetelemetry' as tablename
    from (
        select deviceid,
            locationid,
            telemetryvalue,
            telemetrytime,
            to_char(telemetrytime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24') as dateid
        from gsh.devicetelemetry 
        where 1=1
        and telemetryname = 'cpu'
        and deviceid != 'no-serial'
        and telemetryvalue not like '%null%'
        and telemetrytime < now()
        ) as T
) as T2
where T2.rownum = 1',

query: 'select T2.* 
from (
    select T.deviceid,
        T.locationid,
        T.telemetryvalue as memoryvalue,
        T.telemetrytime as memorytimestamp,
        T.dateid,
        row_number() over(partition by T.deviceid, T.locationid, T.dateid order by T.telemetryvalue desc, T.telemetrytime desc) as rownum,
        'fact.devicetelemetry' as tablename
    from (
        select deviceid,
            locationid,
            telemetryvalue,
            telemetrytime,
            to_char(telemetrytime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24') as dateid
        from gsh.devicetelemetry 
        where 1=1
        and telemetryname = 'memory' --4,470
        and deviceid != 'no-serial'
        and telemetryvalue not like '%null%'
        and telemetrytime < now()
        ) as T
) as T2
where T2.rownum = 1',
query: 'select case when max(cputimestamp) > max(memorytimestamp) \n            then max(memorytimestamp) else max(cputimestamp) end telemetrytime  \nfrom fact.devicetelemetry',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.name, k.kioskid, k.kioskname, o.organizationtype, o.status,

    ToString(c.redeemedRewards)             AS redeemedRewards,
    c.refundedAmount,
    c.refundTransactionId,
    c.refundType,
    ToString(c.totals)                      AS totals,
    ToString(c.totalsCents)                 AS totalsCents,
    c.type,
    ToString(c.upsellInformation)           AS upsellInformation
FROM c
WHERE c.orderDate >= '2026-04-01T00:00:00'
AND   c.orderDate <  '2026-05-01T00:00:00'',
bronzeFolderPath = concat('/orders/raw/', substring(orderDate, 1, 4), '/', substring(orderDate, 6, 2), '/', substring(orderDate, 9, 2), '/', substring(orderDate, 12, 2), '/')) ~> GetDateTimeUnits
